name: brainlife-hello
summary: Tutorial hello-world App that writes the NIfTI header of a T1-weighted image to a text file with nibabel.
description: Tutorial App: main reads the t1 path and main.py dumps the image header to output.txt. It is not an analysis App. Note: main reads config.json.sample instead of config.json, so it ignores the input given on brainlife.

inputs.description: T1-weighted image whose header is printed.
